answer: Random Thread Assignment. Each epoch, a public verifiable random function draws a fresh juniper seed from a committed beacon; the seed deterministically assigns every registered agent to a verification thread of peers it must answer challenges for. An attacker cannot precompute assignments, so each fake identity must survive unpredictable scrutiny from honest agents. Cost: every sybil needs separate live compute and correct responses per epoch, since identities cannot share precomputed answers or bridge effort across threads.
